properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 27 at 1:39AM CDT by NWS Tulsa OK
properties.description:
At 139 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm over
Hoot Owl, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down small tree limbs and blow
around unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation
is possible.

Locations in or near the path include...
Pryor...                          Pryor Creek...
Salina...                         Langley...
Kansas...                         Adair...
Spavinaw...                       Oaks...
Big Cabin...                      Pensacola...
Hoot Owl...                       Rose...
Spavinaw State Park...            Leach...
Chloeta...                        Twin Oaks...
Strang...                         Lake Eucha State Park...
Snowdale State Park...

This includes Interstate 44 between mile markers 260 and 276.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.
